heading.en: Nephi persuades the Lord to replace their war with a famine—Many people perish—They repent, and Nephi importunes the Lord for rain—Nephi and Lehi receive many revelations—The Gadianton robbers entrench themselves in the land. About 20–6 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua faatauanau e Nifae le Alii ia suia la latou taua i se oge—E toatele tagata ua fano—Ua latou salamo, ma ua aioi atu Nifae i le Alii mo le timu—Ua maua e Nifae ma Liae faaaliga e tele—Ua faamausali e le au faomea a Katianetona i latou lava i le laueleele. E tusa o le 20–6 T.L.M.
